target.title: fix(canvas): reject invalid A2UI tool JSONL
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users invoking the Canvas `a2ui_push` tool with malformed or unsupported A2UI JSONL could dispatch the payload to a paired node instead of getting the same Canvas validation used by the node CLI path.

## Why This Change Was Made

Canvas now shares one supported-dialect validator between the CLI `canvas a2ui push` path and the agent-facing `canvas` tool path. The fix stays inside the Canvas plugin owner boundary, keeps A2UI v0.8 payloads unchanged, and preserves the existing rejection for v0.9 `createSurface` JSONL.

## User Impact

Malformed A2UI JSONL and unsupported v0.9 payloads are rejected before `canvas.a2ui.pushJSONL` is invoked, so paired nodes only receive Canvas-supported A2UI payloads from either entry point.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: on current head `5b13855b3269ebfddd363c5b709fa510d1a1e86e`, the real Canvas agent tool execution path rejects malformed JSONL and A2UI v0.9 `createSurface` JSONL after resolving a connected canvas-capable paired node but before `node.invoke`; valid A2UI v0.8 JSONL dispatches to `canvas.a2ui.pushJSONL` on that paired node.
- Paired-node Gateway runtime proof: `node --import tsx --input-type=module -` ran a local WebSocket Gateway that completed the OpenClaw GatewayClient `connect` handshake, returned one connected `canvas-node-1` with `caps: ["canvas"]`, and recorded `node.invoke` calls while executing `createCanvasTool().execute()`.

```text
HEAD 5b13855b3269ebfddd363c5b709fa510d1a1e86e
fixture paired node=canvas-node-1 url=ws://127.0.0.1:53994
malformed JSONL: rejected "Invalid A2UI JSONL:" requests=connect,node.list node.invoke.delta=0
A2UI v0.9 createSurface: rejected "Detected A2UI v0.9 JSONL (createSurface). OpenClaw currently supports v0.8 only." requests=connect,node.list node.invoke.delta=0
valid A2UI v0.8: success requests=connect,node.list,connect,node.invoke node.invoke.delta=1 command=canvas.a2ui.pushJSONL nodeId=canvas-node-1 jsonl.messages=2
node.invoke.total=1
proof result=PASS
```

- Focused regression tests: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/canvas/src/tool.test.ts extensions/canvas/src/cli.test.ts` passed with 2 test files, 26 tests passed, and 1 skipped.
- Committed diff hygiene: `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD` passed.
- Review proof: `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode commit --commit HEAD` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Observed result: the rejected payloads reached the paired-node selection boundary (`connect,node.list`) but produced zero `node.invoke` calls; the valid v0.8 payload produced exactly one `node.invoke` to `canvas.a2ui.pushJSONL` for `canvas-node-1`.
